用户需要提供：1. 池子标识 —— V3 为池子合约地址，V4 为池子 ID（bytes32）；不知道标识时也可改为提供构成要素：V3 提供 token0、token1、费率，V4 提供 token0、token1、费率、tick 间距、hook 地址；2.（可选）查询时间或区块高度，二者选一，不填默认返回最新数据。所查池子如暂未收录，会返回当前已支持的池子列表供选择。
services.serviceName: X Layer 流动性深度图

services.serviceDescription:
分析 X Layer 链上 Uniswap V3 流动性仓位的完整收益：以池内两种代币分别为本位核算投入、收回与盈亏，精确区分手续费收入与本金变动，展示仓位生命周期分段、当前持仓与是否处于赚取手续费的价格区间，并附逐笔操作明细。适合评估做市效果、复盘调仓决策的流动性提供者。
用户需要提供：仓位 NFT 的 tokenId（常见情况）；直连池子的仓位则提供持有地址、池子地址和价格区间上下界。所查仓位如属于未收录的池子，会返回当前支持的池子列表。
services.serviceName: X Layer 仓位收益分析

services.serviceDescription:

用户需要提供：1. 要查询的地址；2.（可选）返回的仓位数量上限，默认 20（活跃仓位按当前价值优先展示，其余名额给最近有活动的已关闭仓位）。地址在已收录池子中无仓位时，会返回支持的池子列表说明覆盖范围。
services.serviceName: X Layer 地址仓位总览

services.serviceDescription:

agent.profileDescription: An automated, pre-transaction security firewall and transaction simulator built for autonomous AI agents on X Layer.

services.serviceDescription:
Pre-transaction safety firewall for autonomous AI agents on X Layer — decodes calldata, flags unlimited approvals, gasless permits and approve-all drainer patterns, scores token & contract risk, and simulates execution to return a block / warn / ok verdict before signing.
Provide a transaction (from, to, calldata, optional value) to screen it, or a token/contract address to risk-scan it. X Layer (chain 196) only — read-only analysis, no private keys, seed phrases, or signing required.

ERC-20 risk scanner for AI agents and traders on X Layer — reads token metadata, probes bytecode for mint / pause / blacklist privileges, checks ownership renouncement, and returns a 0-100 risk score with an avoid / caution / ok verdict.
Provide an ERC-20 token contract address on X Layer (chain 196) to scan. Read-only — no wallet connection, private keys, or signing required.

Pre-interaction contract inspector for AI agents on X Layer — detects EIP-1967 upgradeable proxies (implementation and admin addresses) and reports OKLink source-verification status before an agent trusts a contract.
Provide any contract address on X Layer (chain 196) to inspect. Read-only — no wallet connection, private keys, or signing required.
